children: Forward Industries announced an updated proposal to acquire SkyAI, offering a 50% premium and a fixed 0.306 share exchange ratio.
Proposed acquisition of all SkyAI common stock via merger or tax-efficient combination.
SkyAI holders may elect cash, Forward shares, or a mix; each SkyAI share = 0.306 Forward shares.
Based on Forward’s $6.95 close (Sep 14, 2026), the ratio implies $2.13 per SkyAI share, a 50% premium.
Proposal is non-binding and subject to due diligence, definitive agreement, regulatory approvals and SkyAI shareholder approval.
Forward requested a response from the SkyAI board by 5:00 p.m. ET on September 25, 2026.
